name: svg-follow-scroll
title: SVG Follow Scroll
description: A long hero section where scrolling progressively draws a bright green, looping line across the screen while the headline moves up and a dark title panel slides in.
use: A long marketing page wants a hand-drawn line that ties its sections together as the visitor scrolls.
avoid: It is pinned inside a 350vh section, so it needs a long page and leaves big empty stretches on short screens.
a11y: The decorative SVG has no title and no reduced-motion path, and the drawn line is purely visual. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A large white three-line headline sits centred-left on black with a small grey hint beneath. To its right a thick lime-green line loops in loose scribbles, with parts still undrawn.
behaves: As the page scrolls the line extends further along its fixed path, revealing loops and long sweeps, while the headline slides up and out and a dark panel with the event title rises into view.
customise: Nothing is exposed as props: the headline copy, event panel and the lime SVG path are hardcoded and must be edited in the file.
weight: light: One SVG path driven by a single scroll motion value.
